exposure: Maternal ART initiation during labor and delivery
Frequent hospital admission of the infant
cohort: HIV-exposed infants receiving Prevention of Mother to Child Transmission (PMTCT) follow-up at St Paul's Hospital Millennium Medical College, Yekatit 12 Hospital Medical College, and Selam Health Center in Addis Ababa.
finding: Maternal ART initiation during labor and delivery, frequent infant hospital admission, and mixed feeding were significantly associated with positive HIV serostatus among HIV-exposed infants.
cross-section timing: Data collected from September 2016 to January 2019
